QuestionStmt.S: A liquid drop of volume V is placed on the surface of glass plate. Then another glass plate is placed on it such that liquid forms a thin layer of area A between the surfaces of two plates. To separate the plates a force F has to be applied normal to the surfaces. The surface tension of the liquid is

Solution.S:
Thickness $d = \frac{V}{A}$. Work done to separate plates = $F \cdot d$. Increase in surface area = $2A$ (two new surfaces).

$F \cdot d = T \cdot 2A \Rightarrow T = \frac{F \cdot d}{2A} = \frac{F \cdot (V/A)}{2A} = \frac{FV}{2A^2}$.

Thus the correct option is B.
